text:
paul: Quick design check: new modal flows for Rotate vs Revoke on Credentials page. Figma: https://figma.com/snap/rotate-revoke-ux. Looking for short feedback on copy, keyboard flow, and bulk safety. anya: Love the concept of a softer rotate state. Suggest color language: amber for rotate (informational-warning) and red for revoke (destructive). Also, rotate modal should mention overlap window duration. sam: A11y: when revoke completes, announce via aria-live and put focus on the undo toast. If the key row is removed, focus goes to the table filter. Also ensure modal traps focus and Esc closes. Tab order inside modal should be description -> details -> Cancel -> Revoke. anika: Copy propose short: Rotate header: "Rotate key" body: "Creates a replacement key and keeps the old one active for 2 minutes to allow cutover." CTA: "Rotate and copy" Cancel: "Cancel". Revoke header: "Revoke API key" body: "This will immediately invalidate the key. Any requests using it will fail." CTA: "Revoke key" Cancel: "Cancel". paul: For bulk revoke, require typed-confirm when >7 items and show an estimated impact: "Approx. affected endpoints: ~4" (tooltip: estimate from last 90 days). If estimate unavailable, show "Impact unknown" with help link. anya: Permission chips are noisy in the list. Proposal: compact summary line "Perms: billing, logs +1" that expands on hover/focus. Keeps rows scannable. sam: Implementation snippet for toast: ```html
API key revoked.
``` Make Undo focusable programmatically after toast appears. anika: UX microflow: revoke -> show queued revoke toast for 2 minutes with Undo -> if not undone, remove row and announce removal. For rotate -> copy new key to clipboard and show inline success pill. paul: Edge: deleting an already-revoked key should skip typing confirm. For mixed selection, show counts: "3 will be revoked, 2 already revoked". design-bot: Design review logged. Reviewers: anya, sam. Deadline: 24h.
